name: Students proficient in reading (Spanish) (%)
plain: The share of public school students tested in reading (Spanish) who scored proficient or above on Puerto Rico's test.
definition: The share of students tested in reading (Spanish) who scored proficient or above on Puerto Rico's test. Public schools, all tested grades together, pooled over the students with a valid score; a small school's share comes as a range and its middle is used. Puerto Rico sets its own test (META-PR) and its own line for proficient: do not compare with a state. The newest school-level results a script can read end in 2018-19. The year is the school year that starts in it (2018 = 2018-19, tested in spring 2019).

coverage.frequency: Every school year, 2014-15 to 2018-19; no newer results by school a script can read.

method: proficiency.py reads the all-students rows of the EDFacts assessment file for each school year (all grades together), places each school in a municipio by its NCES id in the Common Core of Data directory of the same year, and pools: a municipio's share is the sum over its schools of (share proficient x students tested) over the students tested. A small school's share comes as a range; its middle is used.
source_detail: US Department of Education, EDFacts state assessment files, school years 2014-15 to 2018-19, via the Urban Institute's Education Data Portal; pooled by municipio
caveats: Puerto Rico sets its own test (META-PR) and its own line for proficient: do not compare these shares with a state's or with NAEP.
The newest results by school a script can read are 2018-19 (2019-20 was not tested); later island figures are in the Department of Education's reports, not by municipio.
Small schools report a range; from the bottom and the top of every range the island's 2018-19 figure is 44.3% to 46.0%.
About 265 schools closed after 2017-18, so 2018-19 covers fewer schools (836 against 1,090); a municipio's share can move because its students moved to other schools.
Check: the Department of Education's own 2018-19 results are 45.1% proficient in Spanish and 30.1% in math.
